headline: Surprising Bruins trending toward being (cautious) buyers on trade market
take: Daily Faceoff says the Bruins, first in the Atlantic at 13-4-1, are trending toward being cautious buyers. Cautious is the right word. Boston has controlled almost exactly half the play (50.6% of the expected goals, the quality of chances), and the record rests on two things that tend to fade: shooters 9.1 goals above their chances and goaltending that has saved 15.5 goals more than expected. That's a good team having a great month. Adding at the deadline makes sense if the target fixes the five-on-five gap rather than rewarding the hot start; a move made on the strength of the standings alone is how buyers end up disappointed in April.
